$comment: Every skill and agent under .agents, where it came from, and its licence. `bun run agents --check` and `tooling/test/skills.test.ts` fail when this file and the tree disagree. Written rather than generated so a reviewer sees the provenance in the diff.

impeccable.why: The design method the prototype phase drives. Vendored rather than installed so a fresh clone has it offline, which is the whole argument of shipping the method with the code.

brand-review.why: marketing-skills. Go-to-market work in the discover and ship phases.

product-development.why: The four-phase method as a skill: discover, prototype, build, ship.

better-auth.why: Which checks belong to better-auth and which to our policies. The traps here are the most expensive in the repository.

effect-sql-rls.why: withOrgScope, the two database roles, and the shape a policy has to take. Tenancy is the one guarantee a wrong edit breaks silently.

tanstack-start-ssr.why: The SSR boundary and the three hydration traps that each shipped once.

effect-form-e2e.why: Forms bound to contract field schemas, and the browser harness's rules.

impeccable-finish-reviewer.why: Judges a finished build against its direction contract. Part of the impeccable distribution vendored beside it.

impeccable-documenter.why: Writes DESIGN.md from what shipped rather than from intentions.

impeccable-asset-producer.why: Produces raster assets from an approved comp.

impeccable-manual-edit-applier.why: Applies live copy edits back to source.

design-sync.why: apps/design and the shipped apps drift silently: a screen with no design screen, a prop the fixtures stopped passing, a persona describing a permission the product does not have. A sweep across three surfaces returning a short list.

tenancy-review.why: New tables, policies and queries against the isolation rules. The one class of finding that is a breach rather than a bug, so it gets its own context window and reports the exploiting request.

contract-drift.why: One handler is served four ways and read by two front ends. What the compiler cannot see — a hydration pair, a reactivity key, the frozen wire types — is what fails in production.

slice-gate.why: Ranks a long gate failure by what it means rather than the order it printed, and carries the known readings for the environmental ones.
